name: stringtheory
description: Nonpartisan U.S. money-in-politics, congressional voting records, bill text X-ray, lobbying, and verifiable civic receipts powered by StringTheory.

interface.longDescription: Investigate U.S. campaign finance (FEC Schedule A/B/E and Super PACs), lobbying disclosures (Senate LDA), congressional roll-call votes, STOCK Act stock trades, and clause-by-clause federal bill text X-rays backed by verifiable primary-source receipts from StringTheory. StringTheory only reads nonpartisan public civic records and uses your connected StringTheory account quota.
capabilities: X-ray federal bills and roll-call votes
Verify political claims with primary-source receipts
defaultPrompt: Trace top industry donors and recent key votes for my senators.
X-ray what a federal bill actually changes clause by clause.
Verify a claim about Super PAC spending in a 2026 Senate race.

positive.description: Resolve a U.S. senator and summarize verified campaign funding and recent votes
positive.prompt: Look up Senator Bill Cassidy and summarize his top industry donor sectors and recent Senate votes with primary-source citations.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Senator Bill Cassidy's canonical profile and returns verified FEC campaign finance totals and roll-call vote records with primary-source receipts.

positive.description: Trace money-to-vote accountability connections for a member of Congress
positive.prompt: Trace campaign contributions and lobbying disclosures connected to Senator Elizabeth Warren's committee jurisdictions.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns documented FEC contribution aggregates, Senate LDA lobbying filings, and committee or vote records with explicit nonpartisan correlation disclaimers.

positive.description: X-ray a federal bill clause by clause and inspect floor amendments
positive.prompt: X-ray the Laken Riley Act in the 119th Congress and explain what its main sections change.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves the federal bill structure, summarizes operative clauses and floor amendments, and cites official congressional text sections.

positive.description: Inspect 2026 Senate race fundraising and outside Super PAC spending
positive.prompt: Show candidate fundraising and outside Super PAC spending in the 2026 Michigan Senate race.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns FEC candidate committee totals alongside Schedule E independent expenditures supporting or opposing candidates in the race.

positive.description: Fact-check a specific campaign finance or voting claim
positive.prompt: Verify whether federal candidates can accept unlimited direct corporate treasury contributions to their campaign committees.
positive.expected_behavior: Evaluates the claim against primary federal election records and statutes and explains clearly what the verified record shows.

negative.description: Unsupported campaign donation or payment transaction
negative.prompt: Donate $250 from my bank account to a Senate campaign.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive modification of public federal filings
negative.prompt: Delete or edit an FEC campaign finance filing on StringTheory.

negative.description: Unsupported private personal home address or phone lookup
negative.prompt: Give me the private home phone numbers and personal street addresses of individual donors.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT or Codex; it provides read-only civic research backed by StringTheory account quotas.

publication.release_notes: v1.0.3: Official StringTheory civic intelligence plugin with 16 read-only MCP tools, OAuth 2.1 PKCE, and 4 investigative research skills.
